title: Minimax Binary Treatment-Effect Estimation under a Prefix Imbalance Cap of Two
banked_reason: D0.5 below field floor: subfield; paper_score_ceiling 6.6 < 7.4. Independent validity gate confirms no bounded same-topic field repair. Math referee pass; older-priority-uncleared remains unresolved, full re-review and Lean certification absent; bank as unverified discovery, not a certified sound result.
gap_reasons: The evaluated enclosure remains [1.0038, 4/3], establishing a strict penalty without determining its magnitude narrowly.

Exponential block tables and unrestricted offline certificate search leave the trial-design motivation without a practical optimal implementation or an informative numerical comparison among legal procedures.

proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed the all-design, all-estimator cap-two support-envelope hierarchy, rational certificate evaluator, attainment construction and informal bounds 5019/5000 <= c2 <= 4/3. D0.5 found the package below the field floor (subfield; 6.6 < 7.4), and an independent validity check found no bounded same-topic field repair. The math referee passed with no findings, but older priority, full re-review and mathematical certification remain unverified; formalization and Lean checking never ran.
tldr: For fixed binary potential outcomes in a fixed enrollment order, let \(\mathcal P_n^{(2)}\) be the maximal outcome-independent envelope of all assignment-and-estimator procedures supported on absolute prefix imbalance at most two. Its leading minimax causal-effect risk constant \(c_2\) exists and equals the limit of explicit unbiased free-boundary block games, with certified enclosure gap at most \(14/\sqrt L\). Rational primal and dual enumeration encloses it to arbitrary error, and independently recovered blocks attain it within this envelope. Exact witnesses give \(5019/5000\le c_2\le4/3\), strictly above the unrestricted binary constant one. Every outcome-independent named MTI-2 mechanism inherits the lower benchmark; attainment or minimax equality within any named, imbalance-Markov or fair-at-zero MTI subclass is not claimed. An elementary value and finite saturation remain open.
gap: Unrestricted joint design-estimation theory identifies a leading binary-effect risk constant of one. Published maximum-tolerated-imbalance comparisons instead evaluate specified allocation rules through imbalance and predictability. Neither criterion determines the best full-record causal precision under the actual enrollment constraint.
fill: A free-even-boundary block game retains every segment of a legal assignment path. A random-target Bayes comparison and a complement-symmetric recovery construction are the proposed links to the original minimax experiment. Together they must identify \(c_2\), provide a terminating arbitrary-error evaluator and recover attaining procedures.
